name: todo-spend-tracker
description: Keep the user's to-do list and spending ledger from what they say out loud. The javis-server dispatcher runs it once per completed recording or keyboard unit; captured to-dos, purchases and done statements are written PENDING and count only once the user confirms them. In chat it answers 'what's on my list' and 'what did I spend this month' from its counting script. Triggers: 'what's on my list', 'what did I spend this month', '待办', '这个月花了多少'.
keywords: what did I spend this month
